name: Weather
reason: Folks, a mid-October week with highs averaging just 15.5C and not a single hot day is too cool for cyanobacteria to really take off, even though the calm, dry 1.0 mm of rain means the water isn't being flushed.
evidence: Average max temp of 15.5C, well below the 30C+ heat that fuels blooms
Only 1.0 mm total rain, so little flushing, but not enough warmth to compensate
Mid-October timing means shorter days and cooling water
